companyFieldUpdates.description: CAG Holdings is Carlyle's U.S. airport infrastructure platform associated with The New Terminal One at John F. Kennedy International Airport. The related project company, JFK NTO LLC, is developing, financing, constructing and will operate a roughly $9.5 billion, 2.6 million-square-foot international terminal with 23 gates under a long-term Port Authority lease. Carlyle originally held a 51% indirect project interest; at financial close on June 10, 2022, Ferrovial acquired 96% of that position and Carlyle retained approximately 2% indirect ownership. Ferrovial's 2026 SEC materials report the current project split as Ferrovial 49%, Carlyle 2%, JLC Infrastructure 30% and Ullico Infrastructure 19%. CAG remains the manager-level PortCo; JFK NTO LLC and the terminal are the associated project rather than separate PortCos. No later Carlyle full exit or signed divestiture was found through August 19, 2026. CAG's platform-level stake, precise legal entry date and current headquarters are not publicly disclosed.
